headline: Data Engineer at ICICI Lombard. Computer engineering graduate (2026) with Honours in Data Science.

points: Build and maintain PL/SQL stored procedures and Oracle data pipelines behind insurance reporting.
Write and tune the SQL that feeds daily loads and business KPIs.
Reconcile data between transactional (OLTP) and reporting (OLAP) systems so the numbers match.
Work with business and analytics teams to turn reporting requests into reliable data.
Designed a Medallion data model (Staging, Curated, Consumption) in dbt and Jinja-templated SQL for BI reporting in Domo and Sigma.
Built idempotent Apache Airflow pipelines moving high-volume data from Google Cloud Storage to Snowflake.
Supported the SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration: remediated legacy tables, updated transformations, validated for zero-defect production data.
Built a natural-language query interface in Retool AI so business teams could query databases without writing SQL.
Researched real-time fraud detection for UPI-style P2P and P2B payments: rule engines, anomaly detection and ML scoring.
Evaluated the open-source Tazama fraud engine for adoption, studying its TypeScript rule logic against Card91's payment flows.
Delivered recommendations and an implementation plan for bringing Tazama into real-time transaction monitoring.
